name: Bangaram Atoll & Coral Reef Lagoon
description: Bangaram is a tiny teardrop-shaped island close to Agatti and Kavaratti. The Lakshadweep Administration describes a tourist resort on the island, the nearby islets of Thinnakara and Parali inside the same lagoon, and phosphorescent plankton that gives the coral sands a bluish glow at night.
how_to_reach: The nearest airport is at Agatti Island; the official page notes boat or helicopter transfer from Agatti. There is no rail or road link to the islands.

name: Agatti Island Lagoon & Coral Atoll
description: Agatti has one of the most beautiful lagoons in Lakshadweep and is the virtual gateway to the islands. Its airport is built on the island, so approaching aircraft look down on the airstrip between the lagoons. The official page also records a 20-bed tourist complex and flights from Kochi.
how_to_reach: Indian Airlines operate flights to Agatti from Kochi. There is no rail connectivity to the mainland and no direct road link to the islands.
practical_notes: Check locally for current entry permits, island transfers, opening times and water-sports rules. Official source verified November 2026.

name: Kavaratti Island & Marine Aquarium
description: Kavaratti is the headquarters of the Lakshadweep Administration and its most developed island. The official page records 52 mosques, the calm lagoon for water sports and snorkelling, a marine aquarium with aquatic specimens, glass-bottomed boats and the Dolphin Dive Centre.
how_to_reach: Reach Lakshadweep via Agatti, then continue by helicopter or vessel; the official island pages quote about 15 minutes by helicopter or 3 hours by vessel from Agatti.
practical_notes: Check locally for current entry permits, island transfers, opening times and water-sports rules. Official source verified November 2026.

name: Kadmat Island & Scuba Diving Reef
description: Kadmat is 8 km long and only 550 metres wide at its broadest point. A shallow western lagoon suits water sports, while long sandy beaches and sandbanks mark the southern tip. The official page notes a Water Sports Institute, a full-fledged scuba-diving centre and visibility of 20–50 metres.
how_to_reach: Reach Lakshadweep via Agatti, then continue by helicopter or vessel; the official island pages quote about 15 minutes by helicopter or 3 hours by vessel from Agatti.

name: Kalpeni Island & Coral Atoll
description: Kalpeni, Tilakkam, Pitti and the uninhabited island of Cheriyam form one atoll. A huge storm bank of coral debris on the eastern and southeastern shores is believed to date from a violent storm in 1847. Visitors can swim, snorkel or reef-walk in the lagoon and use the bathing huts at Koomel Beach.
how_to_reach: The nearest airport is Agatti, followed by about 15 minutes by helicopter or 3 hours by vessel. There is no road link to the island.
practical_notes: Check locally for current entry permits, island transfers, opening times and water-sports rules. Official source verified November 2026.

name: Minicoy Island & Lighthouse
description: Minicoy lies about 200 km south of the northern island group and is Lakshadweep’s second-largest island. The official page describes its large lagoon and Viringili islet, eleven villages known as Ava’h, the Lava dance, Jahadhoni race boats, tuna fishing and an 1885 lighthouse.
how_to_reach: The nearest airport is Agatti, followed by about 45 minutes by helicopter or 8 hours by vessel. Incredible India also notes ships from Kochi.
practical_notes: Check locally for current entry permits, island transfers, opening times and water-sports rules. Official source verified November 2026.

name: Kavaratti Lighthouse
description: Incredible India describes the Kavaratti Lighthouse as a prominent maritime landmark on the capital island. The climb rewards visitors with panoramic views over the turquoise lagoon, Kavaratti Beach and the surrounding coral islands.
how_to_reach: Reach Kavaratti via Agatti by air and onward vessel or helicopter; the nearest airport listed by Incredible India is Agatti Island Airport (AGX).

name: Ujra Mosque, Kavaratti
description: Built by Sheikh Mohammad Qasim in the 17th century, Ujra Mosque is known for sloping tiled roofs, ornately carved pillars and a celebrated driftwood ceiling. Incredible India also describes the wells and tanks behind the mosque and the annual Urs of Sheikh Mohammed Qasim.

name: State Central Library, Kavaratti
description: The State Central Library in the heart of Kavaratti was established in 1958. Incredible India records a collection of more than 70,289 books in English, Hindi and Malayalam, alongside periodicals, digital resources and a community programme of cultural events and exhibitions.

name: Thinnakara Island
description: Thinnakara is a quiet island in the Lakshadweep archipelago, reached by boat from Kavaratti. Incredible India highlights its coral gardens, sea turtle nesting beaches, birdlife, low-impact island stays, vivid sunsets and clear skies for stargazing.
how_to_reach: Begin in Kavaratti and take a boat to Thinnakara; the nearest airport is Agatti Island Airport (AGX).
